versions.changelog:
Initial release – provides practical workflow support for users seeking Proactive Agent-style productivity solutions.

- Helps users fix bugs, improve setup/safety, boost reliability, and create adjacent workflows inspired by proven agent patterns
- Delivers concise work plans, templates, checklists, or automation outlines tailored to user needs
- Prioritizes workflows that run on local hardware (CPU-safe, script, or checklist-based)
- Prompts only for information that materially affects results, making reasonable assumptions when possible
- Outputs are validated against user goals and include verification or next-step notes
